caption:
The beach was supposed to be my 'sensory reset.' Clearly, the universe has a twisted sense of humor. Now my bedroom ceiling is peeling off into grey static, and I’m trying not to heave. I tried to photograph the tear to prove I haven't actually snapped, but the camera insists the room is perfect. My eyes see the glitch; my gear sees the lie.

A growing rift between her senses and her records leaves her trapped in a reality she can no longer verify.

#NeoTokyo #VisualFracture #Glitch #UrbanIsolation #DigitalGhost #RealityCheck
